page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the weak category (bottom 25%). However, the 32 dedicated cores allow the instance to achieve average (middle 50%) multi-core performance, as demonstrated by its stress-ng multi-core score of 23528.93 and Geekbench multi-core score of 8384.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks, including large block read and write tests, also place the instance in the average tier, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage the 32 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, static web serving, and database operations, which all registered average performance in benchmarks. It is less suited for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive applications due to the lower RAM-to-CPU ratio and weak single-core performance. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated physical cores for parallel processing, though the older Intel Xeon architecture presents a performance-per-resource tradeoff compared to newer hardware generations.
